name: content-engine
description: LinkedIn content engine for B2B founders and their clients. From a person LinkedIn + company site: build a machine-readable LinkedIn strategy in Notion (ICP, voice profile, pillars), audit the profile, run a weekly research+recommendation loop, then creative-first voice-true production. Tracking lives in a separate tool. Outputs to Notion in Ukrainian.

linkedin_li_at.title: LinkedIn li_at cookie
linkedin_li_at.description: LinkedIn session cookie (li_at). Used by cookie-based Apify actors to pull Sales Navigator lists (08-engage) and full profile data. Optional — research uses no-cookie actors; without li_at, lists fall back to a one-time CSV export. Creator analytics with impressions belongs to the separate tracking tool.
